analysis: The only change to docs/developer/test.md is a documentation addition at head lines ~2465-2485: a new 'Cluster service listeners after pairing again' section describing ClusterServicePairingChangeTests and ConsolePairingChangeChecks. The supplied base units (lines 1-920) contain no changed lines, and the patch touches only the head-side region beyond the supplied text. No source, configuration, secrets, endpoints or build behavior changed. The new section describes loopback-only tests using a private home, with no production ports or Thunderbolt interface. It describes a security-positive behavior: stale listeners refuse the new pairing after re-pairing, a removed pairing stops both listeners, and an unreadable store is a read failure rather than no pairing. That documents the intended behavior but does not implement or alter it. I found no regression against the threat model: TB-002, TB-003, TB-007, TB-011, TB-012, T-041, A-003, A-008 and A-015 are not affected. The cluster pairing and listener code is outside the supplied evidence (ClusterService, the pairing store), so I cannot verify that the described refusal behavior is actually implemented. That is a documentation-versus-implementation question for any pass that sees the source, not a finding here. The existing base text on SSD test volume selection (DARKBLOOM_SSD_TEST_TMPDIR) and the test-only environment flags is unchanged and pre-existing.
